evidence_boundaries: The CBET experiment measures return within finite diagnostic apertures; the CBET-specific partition relies on fixed-background two-dimensional ray tracing.
The plasma-channel paper directly measures electron spectra and shot stability, while bubble shrinkage and rephasing are supported by EPOCH, FLASH and FBPIC.
The betatron x-ray and downstream electron-transport results are entirely FBPIC, radiation post-processing and ImpactX calculations.
The KSTAR study uses measured magnetic signals but evaluates against full-sensor LIUQE labels; its diffusion sample spread is not calibrated uncertainty and runtime is not real time.
The neutron camera is characterized with Cf-252; ESS event rates, high-energy response and field deployment are simulated or projected.
No radiation-hydrodynamics, PIC, ray tracing, transport, diffusion-model training, equilibrium reconstruction or neutron Monte Carlo calculation was rerun locally.
